description:
Aggregate the storage work: shared captured images, per-record parent handling in redo apply, one no-follow primitive module and one atomic file-publication function.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Capture rounds and materialization plans share the captured image without copying it, and a session recognises its own image by an identity token.
- [hard] REQ-02: Redo apply opens each distinct parent directory once per record, and coalesces directory syncs per parent only if the interruption proof holds; otherwise its rustdoc states why per-operation syncs remain.
- [hard] REQ-03: The no-follow primitives live in one storage module with no import cycle, the leaf-open sequence exists once, and record commit goes through capability handles.
- [hard] REQ-04: One atomic file-publication function with an explicit durability argument publishes lease records, the claims sequence counter, external exports, worktree identity and the server PID file, each with a unique temporary name.
title: Storage primitives exist once and redo apply touches each parent once
